ns2:section.sectionText: Topic: Global Positioning Systems. Prerequisites: ECE 329. An introduction to global navigation satellite systems, with a focus on the global positioning system (GPS). The European Galileo system and the Russian GLONASS system will also be discussed, as will the modernization of the current U.S. GPS. Topics to be covered in lectures and laboratories include basics of navigation, mathematics of obtaining a navigation solution, receiver design and analysis, error analysis and error mitigation.
